article.title: Uninstall an app or investigate disk growth? The AppZapper boundary
article.primaryIntent: Decide whether the problem is removing one unwanted app and associated files, or identifying continuing storage growth from apps the reader still needs.
article.description: AppZapper 3000 documents app-focused removal. Continuing disk growth is a different investigation: establish what changed before choosing what, if anything, to remove.
outline: Top: permitted AppZapper app-window visual, not a landing page; hold until cleared.
Decide whether the app itself is unwanted; use vendor uninstall instructions where relevant (verify Apple/vendor instructions before actionable steps).
Separate caches/preferences/support data from original documents and shared data; no automatic disposable classification.
Explain AppZapper's documented drag/drop/zap path and three-zap trial without claiming testing or complete coverage.
If the app must stay, investigate growth rather than prescribe removal; show labeled Breathing Room Space example preview.
One disclosed comparison arc: Breathing Room, which we build, has source-level storage/activity investigation; explain preview, Python and hosted/paid AI boundaries.
Close with a decision checklist, not a command to delete files.
article.interactionPass: Proposed decision checklist: unwanted app versus needed app, one-off associated files versus recurring growth, supported macOS version, required undo/approval evidence. Non-mutating; no scanner, deletion code or savings estimator.
article.distinctness: Workflow diagnosis, not a renamed feature matrix or a separate AppZapper 3000 doorway page. No invented demand-volume or search-ranking evidence.

comparison.title: Breathing Room vs AppZapper 3000
comparison.primaryIntent: Choose app removal versus storage/activity investigation; adjacent tools, not verified uninstall substitutes.
comparison.format: Concise sourced matrix using claim IDs, decision criteria, honest unknowns, required product visuals, preview/install/hosted-data caveats and workflow-article link.
appzapperAdvantages: Dedicated documented app-removal workflow; Breathing Room full-uninstaller parity is not established.
Explicit one-time purchase and machine-count offers, versus optional recurring Breathing Room AI Care; neither is automatically cheaper for every job.
appzapperTradeoffs: Advertised macOS 15.6+ minimum narrows eligibility compared with Breathing Room's advertised 13+ preview, without proving either works on every eligible Mac.
Ongoing monitoring/developer-cache adapter capabilities, offline/privacy and restore guarantees remain unverified, not absent.
breathingRoomAdvantages: Source-level storage categories, app/process grouping, activity history and developer-cache discovery suit investigation rather than just removing an unwanted app.
breathingRoomTradeoffs: Preview, Python 3.10+, non-notarized release disclosures and unverified clean-machine/Intel behavior.
Hosted authenticated AI is not offline; AI Care has recurring pricing and app-running/saved-approval conditions. No verified full app-uninstaller parity.
